name: Send a trade convoy
notes: DRAFT. One ship to one town; sell and buy there. Back next season (Aquileia: in two).

name: Hold a festival
notes: DRAFT. Games and a feast. Half the effect if held two seasons running.

name: Sacrifice at the temple
notes: DRAFT. The governor sacrifices in public. Pleases the haruspex.

name: Decree honouring Tiberius
notes: DRAFT. An inscription in the forum to the Emperor.

name: Send gifts to Rome
notes: DRAFT. On top of the regular tribute.

name: Listen to the sages
notes: DRAFT. The old men read the sky: you learn next season's wind before it comes.

name: Buy from passing merchants
notes: DRAFT. Greek and Italian ships call at the quay in the sailing season. Buy up to 20 loads at once, no ship of ours needed, at half again the base price (grain 750 a month). No luxuries.

name: Clear new fields
notes: DRAFT. Cut the scrub and build terraces on the hillside: one more field plot, ready in two seasons. At most 16 field plots.

name: Treat with a tribe
notes: DRAFT. Diplomacy and gold: gifts to the chiefs and a d20 with your best talker. Success: they cede land (new field plots) and keep the peace.

name: March against a tribe
notes: DRAFT. Sword and fire: needs 150 soldiers; a d20 battle. Victory: their land and loot, but the tribe stays hostile and raids. Defeat: men lost.
